title: ReviewForge AI
text:
ReviewForge AI

notes:
Lead: CTO (Elena Park). Product team cares about low-latency streaming inside VS Code + PR UI. Wants per-repo model pinning (rules: main -> llama3-70b q4, quick fixes -> smaller low-cost model). Key quote from Elena: "We need actionable PR comments that reduce reviewer time by >30%." Priorities: accuracy of diff summaries, ability to generate multi-comment threads, reranking of suggestions to surface minimal-change fixes first. POC scope: 3 services (python, go, typescript), monorepo with large generated diffs (avg 400 lines change). Latency target: first token stream <150ms for in-IDE; full summarization <4s for diffs <500 lines. Cost sensitivity: aims to cut reviewer hours with cost neutral ROI; price elasticity: willing to pay premium for quality but want optimize suggestions to reduce tokens (batching + prefix caching). Security: SSO via Okta, SCIM, audit logs for generated suggestions, retention controls for user prompts. Integrations desired: GitHub app + webhook for PR events, internal ticketing integration (Jira). Competitive checks: trialing GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Tabnine; GitHub's code review features are good for quick fixes but lack reranking and team-level model pinning. Next step: POC kickoff — need NDA, SOC2 attestation, and test dataset (anonymized). Blockers: legal wants air-gapped option for a regulated customer. AE notes: be concise in pricing; suggest mix of hosted + dedicated for regional demos.

recent_activities:
2026-01-22 — Intro call (AE + SE). high-level use-case: in-IDE PR assistant for enterprise monorepos.
2026-02-18 — Demo: live in-IDE streaming, diff summarization, comment generation. Customer asked about model pinning + versioning.
2026-03-02 — Deep technical call (SE + Eng). Agreed to run POC: 2-week bench vs Copilot on 3 repos.
2026-03-09 — Sent security questionnaire; vendor legal requested SOC2+ISO evidence. Asked for data residency options.

additional_context:
They prefer streaming token model with function-calling for structured comment templates. Interested in Redwood Optimize to tune quantization vs latency. Expecting to invite two pilot customers for joint demos mid-POC.
